snippet.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss - World Premiere Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Galaxies Autumn brings you the world premiere first look at gameplay and a release date for Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss. 

As Noah, an investigator from the occult division of Interpol, you’re dispatched to a mysterious mining station in the Pacific Ocean that has gone silent. Accompanied by your AI assistant, Key, explore the sunken city of R’lyeh, a vast labyrinth of cyclopean architecture. Uncover ancient secrets, solve intricate puzzles, and confront the creeping madness that threatens your sanity. Inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft, this first-person thriller challenges your wits and willpower in a world where reality bends and the unknown lurks beneath
